Sources: FY2025 Form 10-K (accession 0001050446-26-000020, filed February 19, 2026) and the October 2026 special-meeting proxy statement (DEF 14A, accession 0001193125-26-413159, filed October 5, 2026), whose ownership table is as of September 15, 2026 and is newer than the April 2026 annual-meeting proxy. The company changed its name from MicroStrategy Incorporated to Strategy Inc on August 11, 2025 (10-K Note 2). LEADER: Michael Saylor is co-founder, Chairman of the Board and Executive Chairman. The proxy gives him 99.9% of Class B and 32.9% of total voting power, but no percentage of all common shares, so pctEconomic is null and the economic share is in leader.derived (4.75%), down from 7.42% a year earlier because Strategy sold over $16 billion of new Class A stock in 2025 and more in 2026. The proxy's 4.8% 'Beneficial Ownership of Class A Stock (% of Class)' is on an as-converted basis and matches. His total includes 372,575 Class A shares held by a charitable foundation of which he is sole trustee and in which he disclaims beneficial ownership; the proxy counts them as beneficially owned, and so does the derived figure. HOLDERS left empty: the proxy's only other 5% holder is Capital International Investors, 7.9% of Class A on an as-converted basis (13G/A as of March 31, 2026), a single-class percentage, so it is omitted rather than converted. BUYBACKS: the FY2025 cash-flow statement has no line for repurchases of common stock; the company was a net issuer. DIVIDENDS: none on common stock. Strategy paid $381.367 million of dividends on its perpetual preferred stock in 2025 (a separate cash-flow line), which is excluded because it is not paid to common shareholders. Stock comp and geography are small: geography is given to three decimals so the segments add up to the total.
